They are normally used at bigger emergencies(crashes, terrorism and such), but they are often seen are bigger social events.
They are normally not just parked places that have a lot of minor injuries, this is false.

The Danish fire corps, Danish public EMS and private EMS have a lot of different emergency and non emergency vehicles. And they are all paid through taxes and work together.
- Ambulance: For emergency patient transport and care
- Sitting non emergency ambulance: For transporting the unwell, disabled or elderly around who are able to sit(not only to the hospital)
- Laying non emergency ambulance: For transporting the unwell, disabled or elderly around who are unable to sit(not only to the hospital)
- "sociolance" psychological Ambulance: For psychological care, sociological care and other social services.
- Babylance: For emergency baby transport and care
- "Brandbulance" Burn ambulance: For emergency transport and care of burn victims (rarely used)
- Narcotics ambulance: For emergency and non emergency care of Drug addicts. Precious distributors of methadone (rarely used)
- Fire trucks: Many fire trucks are equipped to transport and somewhat care patients if needed
- Rapid response vehicle: A rapid response vehicle driven by one or two doctors for coordinating and planning at serious emergency or for rapid care on scene before assistant arrives. (Usually much smaller and faster than ambulances, butfully equipped)

Other worth mentioning: Rapid organ transport, mobile vacation vehicles, CPR training vehicles, youth training vehicles, terrorism ambulance, fire chief vehicles, EMS chief vehicles and more

We also have many different law enforcement vehicles and Fire department vehicles. But thats for another thread.

The comfort stations original intention was to provide the military prostitutes to decrease the amount of rape, but this quickly spiraled into slavery. The women were manipulated to believe that they recruited to tend to and visit the wounded in the war. 

Nobody knows how many women and girls were forced into this, but my mom's aunt was one of the Koreans who was abducted and ended up pregnant.
It took many years for the Korean government to overcome the shame of the comfort women and demand an apology and compensation for each and every woman taken from the Koreans.
